status: FROZEN AFTER THE MECHANISM ANALYSIS, BEFORE ANY TOBIT FIT WAS RUN
claim_under_test: The NRTI / PI / INSTI v0.1 mutant catalogs were selected by thresholding a multivariate-OLS log10-fold coefficient at >= log10(1.5), fit on a response RIGHT-CENSORED at log10(100) = 2.0. Right-censoring attenuates OLS coefficients toward zero for the effects that drive the response highest. Refitting with a censoring-aware (Tobit) model should therefore RAISE those coefficients, and can only ADD entries to a catalog selected by an upper threshold.
why_this_question: wiki/hiv_fold_censoring_audit_2026-09-22.md measured the censoring and named this as the decidable follow-on it does NOT answer. It deliberately did not claim any published figure is wrong -- only that the response those figures were fit on is censored.

mechanism_analysis_done_BEFORE_freezing.why_this_section_exists: Two acceptance bars earlier in this project were mis-specified by freezing a threshold BEFORE the analysis that says what a correct result can achieve -- one used a NET count to police a DIRECTIONAL failure mode, the other set a target that was unachievable by construction. The numbers below were measured first.
mechanism_analysis_done_BEFORE_freezing.censoring_point: log10(100) = 2.0 on the fitted scale; fold is capped at 100 with NOTHING above it in any of the four datasets

censored_fraction_is_CONCENTRATED_not_un.consequence: most drugs have essentially NO censoring at the record level the catalogs are built on, so a material effect is possible for only a handful of drugs. Any claim of a sweeping effect across all three classes would be wrong on this data.

mechanism_analysis_done_BEFORE_freezing.headroom_at_the_threshold: candidates with an OLS coefficient in [0, 0.1761) -- the only ones that could cross upward: lamivudine 11, saquinavir 10, lopinavir 9, atazanavir 8, saquinavir/indinavir/nelfinavir 8, raltegravir 4, zidovudine 2, elvitegravir 2. A drug with near-zero censoring has headroom but no mechanism to use it.

the_built_in_negative_control_and_it_is_.statement: Tobit REDUCES to OLS as the censored fraction goes to zero -- there is nothing to correct. So the drugs with <2% censoring (tenofovir 0.000, bictegravir 0.000, didanosine 0.001, stavudine 0.002, abacavir 0.003) are a control the data supplies for free.
the_built_in_negative_control_and_it_is_.if_it_fails: coefficients moving materially on a 0%-censored drug means the TOBIT IMPLEMENTATION is wrong (optimizer, scaling, or censoring mask), not that censoring matters. The run must then report IMPLEMENTATION_SUSPECT and interpret nothing.
the_built_in_negative_control_and_it_is_.threshold: max |tobit_coef - ols_coef| over the <2%-censoring drugs must be < 0.01 (well under the 0.1761 selection threshold)

verdict_rule.MATERIAL: the negative control HOLDS and at least one drug's catalog MEMBERSHIP changes at RESIST_COEF_MIN. The published v0.1 gain figures were then computed from a catalog that censoring-aware fitting would not have produced, and re-deriving them is warranted.
verdict_rule.NEGLIGIBLE: the negative control HOLDS and NO drug's catalog membership changes. The censoring is real and measured, but it did not reach the selection decision -- the published gain figures stand as computed, and the audit's concern is closed rather than escalated.
verdict_rule.IMPLEMENTATION_SUSPECT: the negative control FAILS (a <2%-censoring drug moves by >= 0.01). Report and interpret nothing.
verdict_rule.INDETERMINATE: the Tobit optimizer fails to converge on any drug with >= 10% censoring.

directional_prediction_stated_in_advance: for the high-censoring drugs, mean(tobit_coef - ols_coef) over candidates should be POSITIVE (attenuation is corrected upward), and catalog entries GAINED should be >= entries LOST. A net LOSS of entries on a high-censoring drug would contradict the stated mechanism and must be reported as such rather than explained away.
declared_in_advance: This does NOT re-run the 5-fold CV balanced-accuracy comparison and therefore does NOT produce new gain figures. It asks only whether the SELECTION DECISION changes. Re-deriving the gains is a separate job gated on a MATERIAL verdict.
NOT a decoder change under any verdict. No v0.1 catalog is deployed -- hiv_amr.py routes NRTI/PI/INSTI through POSITION-based classes.

The censoring point is INFERRED from a pile-up with an empty tail above it, not read off assay documentation. If the true assay ceiling is not 100, this refit is answering a slightly different question.
Tobit assumes the latent errors are normal and homoscedastic on the log10 scale. That is the same distributional assumption OLS already makes here; it is not additional evidence for it.
The design matrix, candidate set, MIN_CARRIERS and RESIST_COEF_MIN are IMPORTED from the three shipped catalog builders, never restated, so OLS-vs-Tobit is a like-for-like comparison on one design.
